These are '''things named after [[Élie Cartan]]''' (9 April 1869 – 6 May 1951), a French mathematician.

==Mathematics and physics==

* [[Exterior derivative|Cartan calculus]]
* [[Cartan connection]], [[Cartan connection applications]]
* [[Cartan's criterion]]
* [[Cartan decomposition]]
* [[Cartan's equivalence method]]
* [[Cartan formalism (physics)]]
* [[Cartan involution]]
* [[Cartan's magic formula]]
* [[Pure_spinor#Pure spinors and the Cartan map|Cartan relations]]
**[[Pure_spinor#Pure spinors and the Cartan map|Cartan map]]
* [[Cartan matrix]]
* [[Cartan pair]]
<!--* [[Cartan space]]-->
* [[Cartan subalgebra]]
* [[Cartan subgroup]]
* [[Moving_frame|Cartan's method of moving frames]]
* [[Closed-subgroup theorem|Cartan's theorem]], a name for the [[closed-subgroup theorem]]
* [[Theorem of the highest weight|Cartan's theorem]], a name for the [[theorem on highest weights]]
* [[Lie's third theorem|Cartan's theorem]], a name for [[Lie's third theorem]]
* [[Einstein–Cartan theory]]
**[[Einstein–Cartan–Evans theory]]
* [[Cartan–Ambrose–Hicks theorem]]
* [[Cartan–Brauer–Hua theorem]]
* [[Cartan–Dieudonné theorem]]
* [[Hadamard manifold|Cartan–Hadamard manifold]]
* [[Cartan–Hadamard theorem]]
* [[Cartan–Iwahori decomposition]]{{cn|date=May 2026}}
* [[Maximal_compact_subgroup#Existence_and_uniqueness|Cartan-Iwasawa-Malcev theorem]]
* [[Cartan–Kähler theorem]]
* [[Cartan–Karlhede algorithm]]
* [[Representation theory of semisimple Lie algebras|Cartan–Weyl theory]]
**[[Clebsch–Gordan_coefficients_for_SU(3)#Standard_basis|Cartan–Weyl basis]]
* [[Killing form|Cartan–Killing form]]
* [[Cartan–Kuranishi prolongation theorem]]
* [[CAT(k) space]]
* [[Maurer–Cartan form]]
* [[Newton–Cartan theory]]
* [[Generalized Stokes theorem|Stokes–Cartan theorem]], the generalized [[fundamental theorem of calculus]], proven by Cartan (in its general form), also known as [[Stokes' theorem]] although Stokes neither formulated nor proved it.
